fetch_permission.basis: MIT license basis for fetching the reviewed plain-text standard-library documentation. Rust's official licensing page says official Rust projects, including its website, are generally Apache-2.0 OR MIT. This is a copyright-license basis, not a signed permission statement. Robots and exact path scope remain mandatory.
fetch_permission.evidence: Work read-only review 2026-10-14 inspected the three exact seeds and https://rust-lang.org/policies/licenses/, linked from https://rust-lang.org/policies/. Hosted std pages report rustdoc 1.99.0 (b940084d7, 2026-09-28).

storage_permission.basis: Retain the full notice with private corpus data. The current API and UI do not expose this stored notice beside results, so display remains unapproved until the operator reviews whether excerpts may be shown without a per-result notice.
storage_permission.evidence: Work read-only review 2026-10-14 inspected the three exact seeds and the official Rust licensing page. index_permission.basis: Retain the full notice with private indexed content. The policy does not claim that any excerpts may be displayed without satisfying the applicable notice terms.
index_permission.evidence: Work read-only review 2026-10-14 inspected the three exact standard-library pages, their hosted rustdoc 1.99.0 (b940084d7, 2026-09-28) identity, and https://rust-lang.org/policies/licenses/. Images, logos, and third-party material are excluded.

display_permission.basis: This candidate does not expose the source notice alongside displayed excerpts. Do not grant display permission for terms that require a notice with each display.
display_permission.evidence: The checked-in policy stays disabled. An operator must review all display terms and use a client that presents required attribution before granting display permission.
